workCoverage.coverageDescription: Covers the August 16, 2026 Klinswork work period through 14:18 America/Denver: formal execution and closure of WORK-0001 for the Task Assignment and Tracking Project Definition; Work Queue current-state System documentation; Project-local Documentation Viewer companion-resolution changes; validation and architecture reconciliation; post-closure Two-Window Testing; Resource Registry context-routing and spreadsheet-inspection safeguards; pruning of the current Resources map from 48 rows before the recorded cleanup passes to 25 current Resources; Work Queue technical-manual routing reconciliation; and creation of the Work Update Summary master/template architecture.

subject.mainFocus: Using the new Work Unit architecture to complete the second Project Definition exemplar, then empirically testing context restoration and redesigning the Resource Registry and Work Update documentation architecture from the results.
subject.description: Comprehensive August 16 Klinswork update covering WORK-0001, Task Assignment and Tracking, Work Queue System documentation, source-aware Viewer validation, Two-Window Testing, Resource Registry pruning and context routing, spreadsheet inspection safeguards, technical-manual discoverability, and the Work Update Summary master/template model.

narrative.promptingSituation: The August 15 architecture had produced the first Project Definition exemplar and a new Work Unit planning layer, but those structures had not yet governed a complete real implementation Work Unit or been tested for context reconstruction by an independent ChatGPT window.
narrative.initialUnderstanding: The next step was to define Task Assignment and Tracking and Work Queue using the Inventory Management exemplar, while preserving Project/System/Resource/current/future authority boundaries and proving the new Work Unit architecture through real use.
narrative.intendedOutcome: Complete and validate the Task Assignment and Tracking Project Definition and Work Queue System documentation under WORK-0001, then preserve all material Registry/architecture consequences.
narrative.approach: Reconstruct the planning boundary honestly, activate WORK-0001 only after the governing plan was linked, complete Project and System documentation in stages, validate Viewer discovery and semantic separation, close the Work Unit when its completion rule was satisfied, then use Two-Window Testing to evaluate whether the resulting durable context actually worked for a context-naive reader.

progression.title: Recognized and preserved the pre-plan work boundary
progression.description: Project Identity, the Project README, and the Project Summary already existed before the formal implementation plan was created. WUA-0003 preserved that fact rather than backdating the plan.
progression.result: The session gained an explicit reconstructed-continuation planning boundary.

progression.title: Created and linked the governing implementation plan
progression.description: The reconstructed-continuation plan was created and linked to WORK-0001; WUA-0004 recorded formal activation and moved the Work Unit to active/active.
progression.result: Formal execution authority became explicit without rewriting earlier history.

progression.title: Expanded the implementation-plan / session architecture
progression.description: Implementation-plan sidecar and Work Implementation Session structures were strengthened with first-class Work Unit, activation-gate, session, and WUA semantics.
progression.result: The planning/execution documentation model became capable of describing the real session.

progression.title: Added Project-local implementation-plan companion discovery
progression.description: Documentation Viewer builder 2.0.0-draft.3 learned to resolve sidecars/ implementation-plan companions to the parallel implementation-plans/ directory.
progression.result: The real Project Definition layout became discoverable without flattening its directory semantics.

progression.title: Completed the Task Assignment and Tracking Project layer
progression.description: Project Identity, local orientation, Project Summary, structured companion, and plan/sidecar were validated as a coherent Project Definition package.
progression.result: Task Assignment and Tracking became the second working Project Definition exemplar.

progression.title: Completed the Work Queue current/future System layer
progression.description: Work Queue received System-local orientation, a current-state System Summary/sidecar, and a separate Roadmap/sidecar for future direction.
progression.result: Current System interpretation and roadmap intent remained distinct.

progression.title: Validated and closed WORK-0001
progression.description: The Stage 6 matrix passed with non-blocking documentation-freshness notes; reconciliation recorded ACT-0081 through ACT-0084 and ARCH-005; WUA-0010 then closed the Work Unit.
progression.result: WORK-0001 completed at 10:49 with readiness closed.

progression.title: Introduced Two-Window Testing
progression.description: A context-naive Other Window was asked to reconstruct the architecture from durable records.
progression.result: Context quality became an empirical test rather than a design assumption.

progression.title: Redesigned the Registry from test findings
progression.description: The Registry README gained a context-routing index and spreadsheet inspection warning, while the current Resources map was pruned from 48 pre-cleanup rows to 25 current Resources.
progression.result: The Registry became a sparser machine-oriented routing/context layer.

progression.title: Reconciled deep technical-document routing
progression.description: Work Queue documentation was revised so the technical manual is discoverable directly through Project/System routing without requiring prior knowledge of RES-047.
progression.result: Importance was separated from the need for global Resource identity; RES-047 retirement remains pending.

progression.title: Formalized the Work Update master architecture
progression.description: The Work Update Summary Markdown was defined as the canonical detailed master for future AI reconstruction, with sidecar JSON and HTML as downstream structured/presentation products.
progression.result: A specialized work-update-summary-template-1.0-draft.json and this August 16 master were created.

problemsEncountered.problem: Substantive Project Definition work had already occurred before the governing implementation plan existed.
problemsEncountered.effect: A naive retrospective record could falsely imply prospective planning.
problemsEncountered.resolution: Used reconstructed-continuation planning and preserved the exact pre-plan boundary in WUA/session/plan records.

problemsEncountered.problem: The Viewer builder did not resolve a Project-local implementation-plan sidecar to the parallel implementation-plans directory.
problemsEncountered.effect: The new Project Definition layout could not be represented cleanly by existing companion inference.
problemsEncountered.resolution: Added Project-local implementation-plan companion inference in builder 2.0.0-draft.3.

problemsEncountered.problem: Creation-time documentation annotations became stale after the Project/System package was completed.
problemsEncountered.effect: Structurally correct documents could still imply records were pending when they were already present.
problemsEncountered.resolution: Reconciled freshness notes before formal WORK-0001 closure.

problemsEncountered.problem: Serialized spreadsheet inspection returned 443 values for cells that were actually blank.
problemsEncountered.effect: A machine reader could infer false Project IDs or Activity values.
problemsEncountered.resolution: Direct cell verification established literal/effective cells as controlling evidence and ACT-0092 added a permanent Registry warning.

problemsEncountered.problem: The current Resources table contained too many locally discoverable, internal, generated, historical, or duplicate artifacts.
problemsEncountered.effect: Context-naive orientation risked noise and ontology collapse.
problemsEncountered.resolution: Pruned 23 current Resource rows and adopted a sparse routing-map rule.

problemsEncountered.problem: The connected GitHub integration could read repository content but could not write updates.
problemsEncountered.effect: Prepared documentation could not be committed directly through the integration.
problemsEncountered.resolution: Generated downloadable replacement content for manual placement; retain the limitation as a tooling constraint.

problemsEncountered.problem: The current Work Queue README content appears physically as work-queue-README.md while other documentation routes expect README.md.
problemsEncountered.effect: Local semantic navigation may become inconsistent despite improved content.
problemsEncountered.resolution: Identified as post-closure reconciliation work; do not reopen WORK-0001.

unsuccessfulApproaches.approach: Treat every important document or dataset as an independently registered Resource.
unsuccessfulApproaches.whyItWasTried: The Registry began as a practical reference list and global registration made useful things easy to find.
unsuccessfulApproaches.whyItDidNotWork: As the architecture grew, global registration duplicated local discovery, increased noise, and encouraged Project/System/Resource over-assimilation.
unsuccessfulApproaches.whatWasLearned: Global Resource identity should be reserved for independently important routing, authority, dependency, or entry-point needs.

unsuccessfulApproaches.approach: Write the reconciled Work Queue README directly through the connected GitHub integration.
unsuccessfulApproaches.whyItWasTried: The integration could read the repository and the user account had normal repository permissions.
unsuccessfulApproaches.whyItDidNotWork: File update, blob creation, and branch creation returned 403 Resource not accessible by integration.
unsuccessfulApproaches.whatWasLearned: The current connector should be treated as read-capable but not relied upon for repository content writes.

unsuccessfulApproaches.approach: Interpret 'work-update-summary template' as a Markdown template file.
unsuccessfulApproaches.whyItWasTried: The new master document needed a detailed structure and style grammar.
unsuccessfulApproaches.whyItDidNotWork: The intended reusable template artifact was actually JSON.
unsuccessfulApproaches.whatWasLearned: When a record family has both a human-readable master and a machine-readable construction template, name the artifact type explicitly.

keyDecisions.decision: Use reconstructed-continuation planning rather than backdating the implementation plan.
keyDecisions.reason: Some work already existed before the plan authority boundary.
alternativesConsidered: Discard the prior work from the formal record
consequences: The planning schema gained a reusable bootstrap-recovery pattern

keyDecisions.decision: Treat session initiation and activation as distinct events.
keyDecisions.reason: Formal context can exist while an activation prerequisite remains unsatisfied.
alternativesConsidered: Collapse initiation and activation into one event
consequences: WUA-0003 and WUA-0004 preserve separate material state transitions

keyDecisions.decision: Keep System Summary and System Roadmap as separate authorities.
keyDecisions.reason: Current-state evidence and future intent answer different questions.
alternativesConsidered: Merge current and future Work Queue documentation
consequences: Viewer semantics and future context routing remain clearer

keyDecisions.decision: Continue deferring permanent Project/System IDs and System Identity.
keyDecisions.reason: The exemplar is intended to generate evidence before identity architecture is frozen.
consequences: No unsupported durable identity was invented

keyDecisions.decision: Redefine the current Resources table as a sparse routing/context map.
keyDecisions.reason: 2WT showed that exhaustive global registration adds noise and can distort ontology.
alternativesConsidered: Retain every useful artifact as a Resource

keyDecisions.decision: Use direct cell verification when spreadsheet representations disagree with the workbook.
keyDecisions.reason: The 443 defect proved the serialized/table representation can be wrong.
consequences: Registry README now contains an explicit machine-reading safeguard

keyDecisions.decision: Route the Work Queue technical manual through Project/System documentation rather than depending on RES-047.
keyDecisions.reason: The semantic route already exposes the manual at the correct depth.
alternativesConsidered: Keep the manual as a permanent global Resource
consequences: RES-047 retirement became the likely next cleanup action

keyDecisions.decision: Make work-update-summary.md the canonical Work Update master.
keyDecisions.reason: Future ChatGPT needs a detailed durable retrospective source, while the HTML serves a different human presentation role.
alternativesConsidered: Treat the summary as a temporary construction artifact
Make HTML the only durable narrative
consequences: A specialized Work Update Summary JSON template was created
The August 16 Markdown became the first strong exemplar

narrative.methodEstablished: Use durable authorities to plan and execute bounded work, preserve material state transitions in WUAs/Activities, close the Work Unit when its completion rule is actually satisfied, then test the resulting documentation with a context-naive Other Window. Convert observed context failures into routing/authority corrections, and preserve the full retrospective meaning in a detailed work-update-summary.md master before generating sidecar and HTML.
narrative.result: WORK-0001 completed and closed; Task Assignment and Tracking became the second validated Project Definition exemplar; Work Queue gained a distinct current-state System layer and separate roadmap; Viewer companion resolution was extended and validated; 2WT became an empirical context-restoration method; Registry routing became explicit; 23 Resource rows were retired, leaving 25 current Resources; the 443 inspection defect gained a durable safeguard; technical-manual routing was moved into Work Queue documentation; and the Work Update Summary master/template architecture was established.
lessonsLearned: Architecture should be tested by an independent context, not only by the context that authored it.
Recoverable context is not necessarily efficient context.
Project, System, Resource, implementation, path, and lifecycle must remain semantically distinct even in compact routing diagrams.
A globally registered Resource should earn its place through routing/authority/dependency value, not mere importance.
A late-created implementation plan can govern remaining work honestly when the prior-work boundary is explicit.
Event history should preserve imperfect process chronology instead of being rewritten to look cleaner.
Closed Work Units should stay closed; related later work needs its own appropriate scope.
Inspection representations are evidence layers with failure modes and may require direct-source verification.
Detailed Markdown masters and polished HTML products can be optimized for different readers without competing for authority.
Work Update summaries should be retained as durable masters rather than treated as disposable intermediate construction documents.
narrative.directionChange: The day shifted from building the second Project Definition exemplar to testing the durability of the context system itself. That test redirected effort toward Registry routing, Resource sparsity, machine-reading safeguards, technical-document discoverability, and preservation of detailed Work Update masters.
narrative.narrativeSummary: August 16 moved Klinswork from architecture-use into architecture-testing. The morning formally completed WORK-0001 and validated Task Assignment and Tracking → Work Queue as the second Project/System exemplar. The afternoon then used Two-Window Testing to expose context-routing, ontology, and spreadsheet-inspection weaknesses. Those findings produced a major Resource Registry cleanup, explicit context routing, a direct-cell evidence rule, stronger technical-document routing, and finally a new Work Update Summary master architecture designed for future AI reconstruction.

projectDelta.previousState: As of August 15, Inventory Management → Inventory 3.0 was the first Project Definition exemplar, the source-aware Viewer and Record Profile architecture existed, the new Work Unit layer had just been initialized, and WORK-0001 was registered as planned work. general.summary: Klinswork successfully completed a second formal Project Definition, then tested whether a fresh AI context could understand the documentation. Those tests led to a simpler Resource Registry, better routing instructions, a machine-reading safeguard, and a new rule that detailed Markdown Work Update summaries should be preserved as master records.
keyPoints: Task Assignment and Tracking became the second validated Project Definition exemplar.
Work Queue current-state documentation was separated from future roadmap intent.
Two-Window Testing exposed real context-restoration weaknesses and directly changed the architecture.
The Resources map was reduced from 48 pre-cleanup rows to 25 current Resources.
The detailed Markdown Work Update Summary is now the durable master; HTML is downstream presentation.

technical.summary: The work exercised Klinswork's Work Unit, Project Definition, Documentation Viewer, Resource Registry, and retrospective documentation layers end-to-end. Builder 2.0.0-draft.3 added Project-local implementation-plan companion inference; the validation manifest contained 74 valid / 0 invalid records; WUA history carried WORK-0001 through activation and closure; 2WT drove ACT-0091/0092 and a 23-row Resource retirement pass; direct technical-manual routing replaced the conceptual need for RES-047; and a specialized Work Update Summary template was created.

projectSpecificLessons: Task Assignment and Tracking is the durable Project; Work Queue is its principal known System and may change independently.
Work Queue current-state documentation must remain distinct from roadmap intent.
Work Queue deep technical detail can be routed through System documentation without requiring a permanent global Resource entry.
generalLessons: Use independent-context tests to validate documentation quality.
Preserve real chronology even when planning/process infrastructure arrives late.
Separate session initiation from activation when a gate remains unsatisfied.
Keep global Resource routing sparse and semantically purposeful.
Do not infer Project/System identity from Resource routing or physical repository layout.
Verify underlying spreadsheet cells when inspection representations produce unexpected values.
Treat closed Work Units as closed; related later work needs its own scope.
Preserve detailed Markdown work summaries as durable masters for future AI reconstruction.
